stories.title: Schlittler, Rice author 'remarkable' night as Yankees roll in Game 1
stories.summary: Cam Schlittler pitched another playoff gem against the Boston Red Sox, and Ben Rice also burned their hometown team with a late grand slam and six RBIs as the New York Yankees opened this AL Wild Card Series rematch with a 9-0 victory on Tuesday night.

stories.title: Padres pummel Cubs behind Tatis' leadoff blast, King's no-hit bid in Game 1
stories.summary: The Padres made an emphatic statement in their wild-card opener against the Cubs, getting a leadoff homer from Fernando Tatis Jr. and a brilliant effort on the mound from Michael King in an 8-0 win in Game 1.

stories.title: Clark helps keep Fever alive with 'pretty incredible' Game 2 display vs. Aces
stories.summary: Caitlin Clark became the first player in WNBA history with at least 25 points and 15 assists in a game (regular season or playoffs), helping the Fever stay alive with a 99-89 victory over the Aces at Gainbridge Fieldhouse.

stories.title: Aces' Wilson T'd up for confronting fan, fumes over 'unacceptable' behavior
stories.summary: Aces center A'ja Wilson had to be pulled away by teammates after she confronted a fan she said stepped toward her and pointed at her late in Tuesday's Game 2 loss at Gainbridge Fieldhouse.

stories.title: Reeve: Lynx overachieved, 'don't quite have the right group' for playoffs
stories.summary: The Lynx became the first No. 1 seed in league history to be swept in its opening series, marking another heartbreaking playoff exit for the third straight year.
